run.name: Verify all platform downloads and install the exact tap revision
run.command:
set -euo pipefail
brew tap "$QQQ_HOMEBREW_TAP" "$PWD"
test "$(git -C "$(brew --repository "$QQQ_HOMEBREW_TAP")" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
brew trust "$QQQ_HOMEBREW_TAP"
brew readall --syntax --os=all --arch=all "$QQQ_HOMEBREW_TAP"
brew fetch --all-platforms --build-from-source "$QQQ_HOMEBREW_TAP/$QQQ_HOMEBREW_FORMULA"
brew install "$QQQ_HOMEBREW_TAP/$QQQ_HOMEBREW_FORMULA"
brew test "$QQQ_HOMEBREW_TAP/$QQQ_HOMEBREW_FORMULA"
